technique_name: Bird watching - give a description of a particular bird.
description: The Red-tailed hawk is an impressive bird with a wingspan of up to 4 feet. It has a distinct reddish-brown tail and a light brown back. Its wings are broad and rounded, and its head and neck are usually covered in mottled reddish-brown markings. This hawk is often seen soaring high in the sky where it is able to spot small animals from a great distance. It is also quite good at maneuvering quickly in the air and diving on its prey.
